svg.title: Pasar Chow Kit, 06.15, twelve people working
svg.desc: A covered market at mid-morning with twelve traders and staff at work, an office by the gate, a cold store, a corner pitch by the car park and an open drain.

g.text: Pasar Chow Kit, 06.15, twelve people working
One job in this picture is done by nobody. That is the one you can smell by Thursday.
